name: Smudge
bio: Smudge sits at the dinner table like a person, which is how he ended up as the confused white cat glaring at a plate of salad in the internet's most famous argument. Paired with a screaming Real Housewife he has never met, Smudge became half of the defining meme of 2019. For the record: he no like vegetals.
awards: Most disapproving look at a vegetable, all-time
